purpose: Feeds the real update check releases with missing, wrong-key and bad signatures and a good one; checks the changelog and the yes before any core change; injects a failing health check and checks the rollback; hashes the Squire owner's folder through update and rollback; kills an install at every step it names and checks Squire comes back on a healthy version, and changes Claude Code outside Squire and checks it is noticed and checked. Also feeds releases the check cannot run, read or parse, an owner's folder holding entries of every kind, interrupted downloads, and Claude Code changes it cannot read.
title: Signed update, changelog and yes, rollback, and the Squire owner's folder untouched
